title: India's Three-Stage Nuclear Plan

right.title: Thorium
items: One of the world's largest stocks

segments.say: Why does India have its own nuclear plan? Because it has little uranium, but a great deal of thorium, sitting in the sands of its beaches.

anim.title: The catch with thorium
items: Thorium can't split on its own
That needs a reactor already running

segments.say: The catch: thorium can't keep a chain reaction going by itself. It first has to be turned into uranium-233 inside a reactor. So India planned three steps.
Stage one: pressurised heavy water reactors burn natural uranium for power, and leave behind plutonium in their used fuel.

anim.title: Stage 2
items: Breed more fuel than they use

segments.say: Stage two: fast breeder reactors burn that plutonium and breed more fuel than they use, and later can turn thorium into uranium-233.
Stage three: reactors that run on thorium and uranium-233, using India's huge thorium stock for a very long time.

items.text: Plan set out by Homi Bhabha
Core loading at the 500 MW breeder, Kalpakkam

segments.say: Homi Bhabha set out the plan in the nineteen fifties. Stage one is running, stage two's first big reactor began loading fuel in twenty twenty-four, and stage three is still ahead.
For GS Three, remember the chain: heavy water reactors, then breeders, then thorium. Each stage makes the fuel for the next.

sources: Department of Atomic Energy, 'Three Stage Nuclear Power Programme' (dae.gov.in): stage 1 PHWRs on natural uranium; stage 2 fast breeder reactors on plutonium, U-238 and later thorium blankets; stage 3 thorium/U-233 reactors; formulated by Homi Bhabha in the 1950s
DAE / PIB, 4 March 2024: core loading began at the 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor, Kalpakkam
DAE / Atomic Minerals Directorate: India's thorium is in monazite in coastal beach sands; among the world's largest thorium resources

quiz.q: Why does India's plan centre on thorium?
options: India has large thorium and small uranium reserves
quiz.why: India has a great deal of thorium in beach sands, but little uranium.

quiz.q: Which reactors make up stage one?
quiz.why: Stage one uses natural uranium in heavy water reactors.

quiz.q: What must thorium become before it can fuel a reactor?
quiz.why: Thorium is bred into uranium-233 first.
